Welcome to your 9to5Toys Lunch Break Prime Day Hangover Edition. While the big fall Prime sale is over, the Apple deals are flying still and you’ll find the best of them here today. One of the best deals to date on AirPods Pro 3 is still live alongside AirPods Max 2 at $120 off and the all-time lows on the M6 Mac mini at $150 off. You’ll also find the new Apple Watch Series 12 configs still sitting at all-time lows, $200 price drops on M5 MacBook Air models, and the ongoing all-time lows on Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro cases. All of that and more awaits below.

Sony BRAVIA TVs up to $1,000 off at Amazon – OLED, mini-LED, more

Amazon’s Prime Day AirPods Pro 3 deals still live at nearly 30% off, AirPods Max 2 still $120 off

Considering just how many products were on sale yesterday, most of them jumped back up price as Amazon closed the doors on fall Prime Day 2026. The Apple gear, however, not so much, and you can still score one of the lowest prices to date on the wonderful AirPods Pro 3 as well as a deep $120 price drop on AirPods Max 2.

As of the time of writing, Amazon is currently offering Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 down at $179 shipped.

This is a nearly 30% price drop and among the lowest prices we have ever tracked for the world’s most popular earbuds.

Regularly $249, and now $70 off, it’s hard to say for sure how long this deal might stick around for. Only once have we seen them sell for any less at Amazon, and that was a very brief and hard to secure offer at $169 off and on in the middle of the 4-day summer Prime Day sale back in late June.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $179 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (Reg. $549)

The AirPods Max 2 Apple released earlier this year are also still sitting down at fall Prime Day pricing and, much like the Pro 3 above, have only ever sold less than this once at Amazon – the deal we have right now is within $30 of the Amazon all-time low we have only tracked once since release.

Now $120 off the list, Amazon is still offering all five colors down at $429 shipped and thee’s no telling how much longer this will stick around for.

One of this year’s best Prime Day deals is still live: New M6 Mac mini at up to $150 off

Prime Day fall edition is officially over now, but just as we reported previously, there are still some wonderful hangover deals still live (for now anyway). One of which would have to be the M6 Mac mini that Apple just released. You can still land one of these at up to $150 off at the time of writing – easily one of, if not, the best (not so) sleeper Prime Day deals.

Amazon still has loads of banger Apple deals live as of this morning, but some of them are quickly beginning to disappear (mainly the Apple Watch Series 12 configurations). There’s no telling how long these M6 Mac mini discounts will remain, but they are still rolling as of this morning:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $780 (Reg. $899) – Within $11 of all-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $950 (Reg. $1,099) – All-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 24GB/512GB $1,150 (Reg. $1,299) – All-time low
  • 2026 M5 Pro Mac mini 24GB/512GB $1,550 (Reg. $1,699) – All-time low
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio $2,300 (Reg. $2,499) – All-time low

The 2026 fall Prime Day is long gone now, but not entirely. Amazon is still delivering holiday pricing on AirPods Pro 3 and all-time lows on M6 Mac mini, as well as a host of Apple Watch Series 12 configurations. Down below we have gathered all of the models still sitting at the lowest prices ever – get in there as soon as possible as some models are already jumping back up in price.
